retained_foundations.content: Finite-dimensional holomorphic differentiation, compact Haar integration, local Lie group charts and matrix logarithms, elementary differential equations, Taylor's theorem, Bochner integration, L2 density/strong continuity, and bounded orthogonal projection in a complete Hilbert space. No target completion is assumed in K3. The actual derivatives, estimates, closure passage and period kernel are proved in the indicated human claims or inherited proofs.

Finite spectral decomposition and Schur orthogonality for compact unitary modules; orthogonal complements only in finite-dimensional spaces where used for incomplete targets; PBW normal-order spanning via the displayed matrix-unit commutators; algebraic complements of vector subspaces. No discrete-series classification or Bessel multiplicity-one theorem is imported.

The inherited supplied Forms0 datum in the original setting construction. It is required only for BQS23's ConcreteSettingExists consequence, not for QuotP/QuotM, StepStatement or BesselNVGap. No ambient Forms0 existence supplier is asserted.

claim_bindings.scope: Integral compact lowest type from the actual parameter
Actual principal-minor average and normalization
Compact integration-by-parts and local holomorphic kernel
Every derivative is an actual L2 smooth vector
Casimir identity and negative first-layer elimination
Finite PBW-layer coercivity and Vogan norm
Analytic-vector closure and exact compact multiplicities
Irreducibility and the actual matrix coefficient
Every k,r, negative middle vector, original Haar pair and free translates; exact b>2rn^2, including r=0.
Every StepClosed predicate and every natural t, including zero-length and rank-zero segments.
Retains the original odd T and 1801 hypotheses, though the subproof needs fewer numerical assumptions.
All original k>=1,r,u,v,b assumptions; no initial low-gap assumption; exact nonzero period for every sufficiently large integral t.
Every permitted target datum and every nonzero vector; no extra derivative-decay or Bessel-uniqueness premise.
Conditional on BesselAll; every original supplied representation, lowest unit vector, compact type, character and Haar pair.
Explicitly conditional on the full original StepStatement; Forms0 retained for the setting; no whole selected obligation closure.
Every k,r>=0 and original signature, including proof that the impossible q0=0 case is excluded by StepGap itself; exact beta/2 and beta/4 thresholds.

Arbitrary dimension and signature at original hNeed/q0/HC/gap scope; every compact kernel type and exact IsMu. Broader cyclic rigidity proved only at h>hNeed, not at every weaker ClosedIrreducibleLowestTypeData scope.
Any original unitary derived datum satisfying the coefficient identity, without irreducibility of the ambient representation; every complex omega and every generated-module vector.
Every original Cayley, Bessel datum, weak Haar pair, xi and free translate; original local ambient smoothness and every right derivative word at exponent 1-aExp.
Every original Wf,W', compact stability, image, Casimir and period-injectivity hypothesis; unchanged Haar/character/compact data. Shifted quotient existence is not asserted.
All derivative words satisfy the original exponent 1-aExp; every word lies in the actual L2 space, giving full IsSmoothL2.
Both complementary expansions, exact left operator order and shifts x-1 and x-m, including m=0.
Arbitrary complex module and stable submodule annihilated by the Capelli operator; every original y, beta, v and real omega.
Both standard/dual tensor representations and Casimirs; no nonzero eigenspace vector or shifted quotient existence is asserted.
Retains full original EvalP, EvalM, QuotP, QuotM at unchanged scope; every original parameter, exclusion, Bessel datum and Haar pair.
All original data and quantifiers, exclusion u_j != lambda_s+1/2, actual standard tensor map and original operator period; witness y=Q^-1 e_j*; k=0 and r=0 included.
All original data and quantifiers, exclusion u_j != lambda_s-1/2, actual dual tensor map and original operator period; witness alpha=last row of Q; k=0 and r=0 included.
Retains the complete original QuotP and QuotM; then gives both Step directions, BesselNVGap, and the original setting only on its inherited supplied-Forms0 scope.

Whole original WFromLoc; BesselNVGap implies WExists. On the inherited supplied Forms0 scope, the completed blocks give ConcreteSettingExists, retaining the nonvanishing premise and all original choice order.
One dependent sequence of A,L,P,Rf,Xu,Bu,Pi,Mu on the same D; retains original Forms0/gap and remaining W/measured/tie/count/common-family producers.

Simultaneous prescribed infinity/global-H/local-S measures and unipotent covolume one on one MeasW, with exact existing infinity ties preserved for every word; remaining orbital/fiber identities explicit.
